yield.series: Investing.com UST 10Y yield daily weekday closes
yield.method: Wilder RSI(14): first 14 arithmetic-average changes, then (previous*13+change)/14; excludes current session and weekends.

signalRules.repeat: Once per uninterrupted monotonic run; zeros, missing values and opposite direction reset.
signalRules.timing: First date satisfying both filters; never backdated to the pivot.
signalRules.validation: Display convention only; not statistically significant or backtested.
